lines: Caveman uses 33.2% fewer input tokens for whole coding sessions while keeping every answer correct.

Agents talk too much when reading huge logs or tables.
Caveman stops the chatter to save your tokens.
Caveman is a simple skill that makes your AI agent speak clearly and quietly for all coders.
It strips articles and extra phrases from your agent's replies without losing any facts or code.
Watch CSV drop 28041 to 314 tokens or logs shrink from 22810 down to 348.
Logs cut to 98.5% smaller than the original file size. The skill shrinks data while keeping every number exact.
Web pages drop to 121 tokens instead of 15704 for agent browsing.
It keeps every path and error message intact while shrinking code blocks to fewer words.
Apache licensed by Julius Brussee with 110,358 stars and trusted by Adobe Research.
Run npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman -g in your terminal to start using the skill now.
